brief:
Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot met with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for a security briefing, Al-Monitor reported. The meeting came as opposition figures expressed worry that the government might launch a military operation against Iran.

Eisenkot's visit reflected broader political tensions over potential Iranian escalation. Opposition members have voiced concerns about unilateral government action on the matter without broader consensus.
dek: Yashar leader Gadi Eisenkot met Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for a security briefing amid opposition concerns that the government could launch a military operation against Iran.
title: Eisenkot meets Netanyahu amid Iran strike concerns
